glosses: to play a string instrument badly; to rasp
grać nieumiejętnie na jakimś instrumencie, zwłaszcza strunowym

examples.text: Przestałabyś już rzępolić na tym pianinie.

glosses: A coarse file or filelike tool, on which the cutting prominences are distinct points raised by the oblique stroke of a sharp punch, instead of lines raised by a chisel, as on the true file.
The sound made by this tool when used, or any similar sound.

examples.text: the rasp of her perpetual cough

glosses: To make a noise similar to the one a rasp makes in use; to utter rasps.
To say in a raspy voice.

examples.text: “No. I am going to feed you to the children,” rasped Burt, his laugh rattling around his throat, prising Dad’s fingers one by one off his apron.

glosses: To work something with a rasp.

examples.text: to rasp wood to make it smooth

glosses: To grate harshly upon; to offend by coarse or rough treatment or language.

examples.text: Set sorrel amongst rasps, and the rasps will be smaller.

glosses: suonare uno strumento musicale a corda o tastiera in modo maldestro o da principiante
